label: Tracks belief S1 is good (down at D1, up at D2); dips at GO after no reward.
terms: (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * np.abs(belief_lo)
explanation: Raw reset gate r16 is almost entirely timing (high ~0.96-0.99 at D1/GO, ~0.03-0.09 at D2; timing R^2 ~1.00), so the residual is small. Beyond timing: at D1 it is slightly lower when the ideal observer believes S1 is good (and higher after an a2 choice); at D2 it is slightly higher when belief favours S1 (and when S1 is reached); at GO it dips after an unrewarded trial, much more so after runs of 2-3 unrewarded trials (the largest residuals, dips to ~0.5, occur at GO during unrewarded streaks, often while repeatedly choosing a2 and landing rarely in S1). The free fit adds the previous choice at D1, the reached state at D2, graded unrewarded-streak depth at GO and GO belief certainty. Future reward adds nothing (reference 0.00). Observed-only; no model outputs used.
